title: Phuphi amma
body:
Sakina(sa) ne kaha kya hogaya aakhir Phuppi amma
Na aaye shaam me (2)
Is saal q zaayer Phuppi amma
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Haram me inke aane se badi raunak si rehti thi
Ye jab padhte the nauha ik nadi ashko ki behti thi
Duaaein maangte the ye to mai aameen kehti thi
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Haram veeraan hai chaaro taraf chhaya hai sannata
Azadaro k aane se behel jaata tha dil mera
Kaha hai kuch kisi khaadim ne ya hai mujhse kuch shikwa
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Wahi daure Yazeedi(la) phir palattkar aa gaya shaayad
Yahaa'n par phir koyi Shimre sitamgar(la) aa gaya shaayad
Guluye haq pe phir zaalim ka khanjar aa gaya shaayad
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Naa koyi maatami aaya na ab k koyi nauhakhwaa'n
Alam uththa julus aaya na koyi nazr ka saamaa'n
Musallo'n par udaaasi chhaayi hai khaamosh hai Quraa'n
<<DIVIDER>>
5. "Raza Imran" Shehzaadi(sa) ko bas itni khabar de de
Hamari zindagi hai naam tere chaahe jab le le
Hai saare raaste hi band Bibi(sa) aaye hum kaise
